source: gpt-image built-in plus canonical PS footprint normalization

generationDefinition.assetType: production 2D isometric ground decal for a photorealistic WWII tactical game
generationDefinition.referenceRole: edit target and absolute footprint, orientation, camera, palette, and lighting reference
promptContract: Faithfully reconstruct and upscale exactly the same isolated ground asset at substantially higher photographic detail. This is not a redesign.

Preserve the exact footprint proportions, long-axis direction, internal mass distribution, elevated 2:1 isometric/top-down viewpoint, muted low-contrast PS-era battlefield palette, and soft overcast upper-left lighting.

Lighting/mood: use only the shared ps-overcast-upper-left-v1 lighting: one large soft neutral key arriving from screen upper-left, high overcast ambient fill, highlights on upper-left-facing relief, and every micro-shadow or cast shadow toward screen lower-right. No second light, front flash, rim light, hard sun, HDR, or cinematic grading.
Change only resolution and plausible sub-pixel material detail. Do not add new semantic features, change perspective, enlarge the footprint, or create a raised object.

Render on a perfectly flat uniform solid #ff00ff chroma-key background with no gradient, texture, lighting variation, floor plane, contact shadow, reflection, text, border, watermark, or extra objects.

perFamilyConstraints.terrain: Preserve the irregular edge erosion and tiny embedded stones; no tracks, puddles, grass clumps, or mound.
perFamilyConstraints.road: Preserve two wheel ruts, central ridge, broken ends, width, and direction; no tread pattern, deep trench, or raised roadbed.
perFamilyConstraints.field: Preserve row count, gaps, spacing rhythm, tapering ends, and direction; no crops, extra rows, or embankment.
perFamilyConstraints.crater: Preserve the shallow dark depression, irregular rim, and radial ejecta; no fire, smoke, glow, deep hole, or dramatic high rim.

postprocess.matte: remove_chroma_key.py with border auto-key, soft matte, thresholds 12/220, and despill
postprocess.canonicalAlpha: 2x LANCZOS alpha from the PS reference
postprocess.colorGrade: weighted per-channel mean and standard deviation match to the PS reference
